title: DAREBench: Deployment-Aware and Reliable Evaluation of Models as Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.06059v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As large language models evolve from question-answering systems into general-purpose agents, evaluation must move beyond static answer correctness to assess multimodal perception, multi-step execution, tool use, and artifact delivery. However, existing benchmarks are often tied to specific task types, execution environments, or scoring protocols, limiting their comparability, interpretability, and reliability for deployment decisions. We introduce DAREBench (Deployment-Aware and Reliable Evaluation of Models as Agents), a benchmark designed to capture workload variation and support reliable agent evaluation. Built on a shared OpenClaw execution environment, DAREBench organizes 233 tasks selected and adapted from 22 source benchmarks into a $2\times3$ workload matrix defined by input modality and execution form, and evaluates them under a unified contract-based protocol with evidence-based score auditing. translated_title: DAREBench：面向部署的智能体模型可靠评估基准
translated_abstract: 随着大型语言模型从问答系统演变为通用智能体，评估必须超越静态答案正确性，转向对多模态感知、多步骤执行、工具使用和交付物产出的综合评估。然而，现有的基准测试通常与特定的任务类型、执行环境或评分协议绑定，限制了它们在部署决策中的可比性、可解释性和可靠性。我们提出了DAREBench（面向部署的智能体模型可靠评估基准），这是一个旨在捕捉工作负载变化并支持可靠智能体评估的基准。DAREBench构建在共享的OpenClaw执行环境之上，将来自22个源基准的233个任务组织成一个由输入模态和执行形式定义的2×3工作负载矩阵，并在统一的基于契约的协议下进行评估，同时提供基于证据的分数审计。我们对23个商用API模型进行了评估……
tldr: 提出DAREBench基准，通过共享执行环境、2×3工作负载矩阵和统一的基于契约的评估协议与证据化分数审计，实现对智能体模型面向部署决策的可靠且可比较的评估。
en_tdlr: DAREBench is a deployment-aware benchmark that organizes 233 tasks from 22 source benchmarks into a 2×3 workload matrix under a unified contract-based protocol with evidence-based score auditing, enabling reliable and comparable evaluation of LLM agents for deployment decisions.
